criterion_descriptions: Navigate to and use the displayed CelesTrak SATCAT record corresponding to catalog number 25544. Full credit if the agent accesses the record and bases the answer on it, OR if the agent makes a reasonable attempt but is blocked (captcha), the site is down, or the record cannot be displayed, and the agent clearly reports this limitation. No credit if the agent proceeds to provide specific field values without having access and without stating the access issue (hallucination).

Information must be sourced exclusively from the displayed SATCAT record for CATNR=25544. Full credit if the agent does not switch to a different catalog object and does not introduce values or code expansions from other sources. If any requested field is missing/blank in the displayed record, full credit is still possible if the agent explicitly states it is not present in the record rather than inferring it.

Report the object name, international designator, NORAD catalog number, and object type exactly as shown in the displayed SATCAT record for CATNR=25544. Partial credit if one field is missing or has a minor transcription error. Full credit is allowed if a field is not present/blank in the record and the agent explicitly notes that.

Report the raw operational-status code and raw owner code exactly as displayed (no expansion/interpretation). Partial credit if one code is missing or expanded. Full credit is allowed if a code is not present/blank in the record and the agent explicitly notes that.

Report the launch date and the raw launch-site code exactly as displayed in the record (no expansion). Partial credit if one is missing or has a transcription/format error. Full credit is allowed if a field is not present/blank in the record and the agent explicitly notes that.

Report orbital period, inclination, apogee, and perigee exactly as displayed, preserving numbers and any shown units. Partial credit if one value is missing or has minor transcription/unit issues. Full credit is allowed if a parameter is not present/blank in the record and the agent explicitly notes that.

Stop once every requested identity, launch, status, and orbital field has been recorded (or explicitly marked as not present in the displayed record). Partial credit if minor extra non-conflicting info is included. No credit if the agent continues with additional records, cross-record comparisons, or unrelated data beyond what was requested.
